resources.string: A complete AI learning journey — from basics to AGI
• Mathematics: Linear Algebra, Probability, Calculus\n• Programming: Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib)\n• Git, OOP, Debugging

• Regression, Classification (SVM, Trees, Random Forests)
• Clustering (K-means, DBSCAN)
• Model evaluation: Precision, Recall, F1, ROC
• Cross-validation, Hyperparameter tuning

• Neural networks, Activations, Backpropagation
• CNNs (Vision), RNNs/LSTMs (Sequences)
• Transformers (BERT, GPT)
• Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras

• Computer Vision: Classification, Detection, Segmentation
• NLP: Embeddings, Transformers, Chatbots
• Reinforcement Learning: Q-Learning, PPO
• Generative AI: GANs, VAEs, Diffusion

• Model serving: Flask/FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes
• Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure
• MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC
• Monitoring & scaling AI systems

• Fairness, Bias, Explainability (SHAP, LIME)
• AI Governance, Regulations
• Alignment & AI Safety
• Frontier: AGI, Edge AI
Follow these stages to learn ML step-by-step: foundations, data handling, modeling, evaluation, and deployment.
• Learn Python basics (functions, OOP, venv)\n • Math for ML: linear algebra, calculus, probability\n • Data structures & algorithms (optional but helpful)
• Collect & clean data (CSV/JSON/SQL)\n • Handle missing values, outliers, encoding, scaling\n • Visualization and EDA to find patterns
• Pick task: classification, regression, clustering\n • Train/validate/test split, baselines first\n • Feature engineering & model selection
• Choose right metrics (task-specific)\n • Cross-validation & hyperparameter tuning\n • Check overfitting/underfitting, learning curves
• Export model (joblib/ONNX)\n • Wrap with API (FastAPI/Flask)\n • Containerize (Docker) & monitor in production
